description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the IDs of hybrid cloud clusters.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time is in UTC.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time is in UTC.

description.zh:
风险统计的状态列表。

>默认统计 **toBeConfirmed**、**toBeFixed**、**toBeVerified**、**notFixed**状态的风险数据。
description.en:
The list of risk states for which to collect statistics.

> By default, statistics are collected for risks in the **toBeConfirmed**, **toBeFixed**, **toBeVerified**, and **notFixed** states.

title.zh: 查询API安全用户风险类型和统计

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-abnormal-type --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-g4000201 --cluster-id 993 --start-time 1723435200 --end-time 1726113600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-ac000lani --user-status-list toBeConfirmed --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeUserAbnormalType --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-ac000lani' --UserStatusList.1 toBeConfirmed --EndTime 1726113600 --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-g4000201' --ClusterId 993 --StartTime 1723435200 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
